translation: I consider myself a mote of dust, and the grass and trees flourish and die; what does it matter to weight and lightness, having and not having? Yet I was able to bathe in the grace of the sage and bright, and retiring, fulfill my wish for forest and spring; Heaven above silently blessed me; how deep is the endowment of talent! The feathers gradually return to the land, and the tail hides and dives into the deep; one garment and one meal, with nothing sought outside, not hearing and not asking, self-content and self-joyful, placing all worldly affairs outside consideration; this is resting myself in the rear. I am not willing to follow the scholar who avoids people; discussing dreams with those who dream is already meaningless, and expecting to dream again after dreaming is not even more meaningless? I am not willing to follow the scholar who avoids the world; playing along with the occasion is already felt to be false, and performing a solo play after the stage is not even more false? Rest, and rest! Does a person rest me? If a person does not rest me, I rest the person.
